column4: swarm-related-attrib: tex 310-311 "Blackadar and Kirchberg introduced the notions of MF and NF algebras [BK94]"; the notions are IsMFAlgebra/IsNFAlgebra, with sanity endpoint (NF => separable, nuclear, MF; C and M_{m+1}(C) MF; MF => stably finite) in RelatedAttribution/MFNotionsAndQuestions.lean; the 1994 credit is attribution

swarm-related-attrib: tex 319-321 "The question without nuclearity, whether every stably finite C*-algebra is MF, is the MF problem [GH S6]"; MFProblem (separable stably finite => MF); endpoint proves MF => stably finite, MFProblem => every countable group MF, and not MFProblem (reused from thm:headline, rank four); the BK/GH credit is attribution

swarm-related-attrib: tex 325-327 "CDE introduced MF groups [CDE], and whether every countable group is MF remained open [Korchagin, BDL]"; notion IsCDEOperatorMF, question EveryCountableGroupIsMF, answered negatively with a countable non-MF witness (reuses manuscriptNotEveryCountableGroupIsMF, manuscriptCountableNonMFGroupExists); "remained open" is history, not formalized

swarm-related-attrib: tex 349-351 "The group H is the group of [OAI], and thm:torsion-free reuses Fournier-Facio's configuration [FFF]"; credit only; realized by H = EL4(R) iso R^x (unitsEquivHeadline), the FFF datum PrintedFournierFacioData proved to be an OAI configuration, and lem:commutator-in-defect; existence of the FFF group (FournierFacioParagraph) and thm:torsion-free stay partial (row 0f22bdbc4184)
